services.desc: Generally, lessons are on Mondays, Tuesdays, or Thursdays in the mid to late afternoon or early evening. The student is generally expected to keep the same weekly lesson time slot for the whole session. Tuition is prorated depending upon the number of weeks remaining in the session at the time of registration.
